reason: An offline Node.js CLI for managing DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces, including listing, deletion, trash-based restoration, permanent purge, and cleanup of missing session records in local DSH storage.

summaries.zh: 用于在终端中管理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区会话的离线工具，支持列出、删除、恢复和清理本地会话数据。
summaries.en: An offline CLI for managing DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions by listing, deleting, restoring, and cleaning local session data.

capabilities: Deletes sessions from local DSH storage
Moves deleted sessions to a trash area and restores them
Permanently purges trashed sessions when requested
Prunes missing session identifiers from workspace records
Writes backups and updates local account and projection cache files
Detects whether the local DSH service is running before modifying data
